title: Movie night, but make it fondue 🍫
description:
A whole chocolate fondue in one little mug, right on the coffee table.

The white Meltie Mini Fondue Mug on a sitting-room coffee table: malt balls in, tealight lit, waffles and marshmallows dipped and dripping. A mini chocolate fondue in one mug for movie nights, cosy evenings and gifts.
